status: PROPOSED, pending root freeze; no candidate verdict
interpretation: The fixed target guides warm softly lit cartoon stone volumes and material character. Its single view does not prove camera, registration, unseen sides or cut profiles. Reward useful native modeling improvements; the old one-mesh core, part count, facet layout and horizontal dark bands are not locks.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Several readable large rounded/faceted stone masses should give this narrow straight blue barrier convincing depth. Use a controlled silhouette and purposeful broad form breaks within the finite functional strip. Improve the weak flat slab construction without turning the narrow barrier into a broad shelf or inventing another terrain role.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.verification: All four registered facings at published2x, logical1x and phone scene scale, plus native and independently composed repeats. A view with little new contour can still succeed through useful volume, surface curvature and material separation.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: Keep cobalt/blue stone with cyan upper planes, distinct readable midtones and sparse deeper blue recesses. Broad soft highlights should explain rounded planes without a preferred horizontal key. The bottom must retain readable blue volume instead of a nearly black horizontal dead band. Restrained creases and a few purposeful small stone details may enrich the form, while avoiding white glare, uniformly outlined rocks, microtexture, glow or unrelated decorations.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.verification: Compare target/original/candidate on neutral light, gray and dark grounds at matched full-canvas registration. Inspect the cap faces and narrow E/W views as well as the broad N/S faces. No foreground-intensity rule is borrowed from another object; this is opaque blocking world terrain.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.desired: No clipping, coplanar flicker, black pits, muddy merged masses, floating base, exposed internal cut, abrupt normal break or new seam stripe. Repeat modules must form a coherent continuous blue stone barrier with the exact finite port section, both natively and after independent published-sprite composition. Native cut material/normal transitions may be redesigned to achieve this; the old cap/top color discontinuity is not a lock.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.verification: Four native and independent W/E-axis repeats, close seam crops and phone/common-canvas browser screenshots in both required headless modes. Diagnose finite geometry, alpha coverage and opaque RGB discontinuities separately.

useSizeDetail: Large shape planes and stone groupings must survive logical and phone scale. Do not require a particular number of stones, copied cracks, bright rim width, or target detail that needs image warping or breaks the ports.
acceptanceBoundary: Approval later requires visible useful improvement, all frozen technical constraints, complete declared visual coverage and passing unchanged acceptance checks; scores alone never approve. Preparation here issues no approval.
